newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot gas mostly stronger amid tight supply.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot gas mostly stronger amid tight supply.

text.p: Canadian spot natgas prices were mostly stronger Tuesday, as field receipts still failed to appear in Alberta and eastern prices were lifted by higher U.S. prices, market sources said.
"I don't think the production is there. It's mystery production. Field receipts are less than they expected," one Calgary-based trader said.
Spot gas at the AECO storage hub rose by about five cents to C$1.62-1.63 per gigajoule.
July AECO was quoted at C$1.61-1.62, while one-year pricing climbed to about C$1.75-1.76, traders said.
